free_tier.stated: No quota of its own — it multiplies the 1TB item limit by however many versions you PUT.

egress.terms: Free (history files are served through the same item path)

tooling: raw IAS3 PUT header; rclone does not expose it, so a thin curl/requests shim is needed
chaining: A 20TiB cold archive can be stored as ~20 versions of a 1TB item if the payload changes, or used as a free append-only version store per key. Combined with x-archive-cascade-delete:1 for cleanup.
limits_note: For multipart the header must be set at multipart-complete time; each version re-enters the per-item queue.

identity_cost.detail: inferred from the category 'academic'; the source record states no identity cost, so this is a class assumption, not evidence

reliability_note: Unofficial-ish surface: documented but not exposed by any major client, so it is untested at scale and easy to orphan copies with.

evidence.proved: 'For multipart, the x-archive-keep-old-version header must be specified at the time the multipart upload is completed'

notes: No quota of its own — it multiplies the 1TB item limit by however many versions you PUT.
